issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) silently changes resolvedSources contract without a unit test or documented precondition.
issues.detail: The DecodedMap change is correct per the sourcemap spec, but it assumes `from` is a file path so `..` strips the filename. Behavior diverges if `from` is empty, a directory, or a URL. No direct unit test in packages/utils covers resolvedSources; only a snapshot in test/cli proves it. Document the precondition and add a negative-path test so this doesn't regress.

issues.description: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns '{}' as a sentinel, lying to convert-source-map about missing files.
issues.detail: Returning the literal string '{}' conflates 'file missing' with 'empty JSON map' and relies on an undocumented quirk of convert-source-map tolerating that exact shape. This hides real problems (broken sourceMappingURL, missing .map file) behind a silent no-op. Return undefined/null and let the caller handle absence explicitly, or log once at debug level.

issues.description: Synchronous readFileSync on every error frame with no cache and no try/catch on a hot error-serialization path.
issues.detail: getSourceMap is invoked per frame during error serialization, re-reading the same file and its .map on every call. readFileSync can also throw (EACCES, EISDIR, symlink loop), which would replace the user's test failure with a sourcemap error. Cache by file path and wrap in try/catch so failures fall through to no source map. Specify: never throw, return undefined on failure.

issues.description: Source-map helpers live in test-run.ts but belong with the source-map utilities.
issues.detail: extractSourcemapFromFile and createConvertSourceMapReadMap are general-purpose source-map helpers, not TestRun lifecycle code. Placing them in test-run.ts couples unrelated responsibility to the run reporter module. Move them into packages/utils/src/source-map.ts (or a sibling) so the module boundary matches responsibility.

issues.description: Mixing 'pathe' and 'node:path' imports in the same file with no reason.
issues.detail: The file already imports resolve from 'pathe' at the top. The new code imports node:path and uses path.resolve/path.dirname. Pick one — the codebase's voice is pathe; match it unless there is a concrete reason, and there isn't here.

issues.description: Snapshot pins the happy path but failure modes (missing map, malformed map, file moved) are untested.
issues.detail: The snapshot diff asserts external-module frames resolve to original .ts sources, which is good. But there is no test for the fallback contract: when getSourceMap returns undefined or the map is malformed, stacks should fall back to the transpiled location without crashing. Add negative-path tests pinning this behavior.

synthesis.summary: The fix is directionally correct: the DecodedMap one-liner restores sourcemap-spec behavior for resolvedSources, and the external-module path in test-run.ts now correctly maps stack frames to original .ts sources. But the implementation has the smell of a deadline patch — synchronous readFileSync on every error frame with no cache and no try/catch, a fake '{}' return that lies to convert-source-map about missing files, and source-map helpers placed in the wrong module. Contracts on the new getSourceMap hook and on DecodedMap's `from` parameter are unstated. NEEDS-WORK before landing: cache and guard the read, stop returning '{}', document the contracts, and add direct unit tests for resolvedSources plus negative-path tests for missing/malformed maps.
